notes.title: Major Demo Update v1.2 – New Hero, Stats, UI Improvements & More!
notes.content:
The Slime Attack: Survivor demo just got a huge upgrade — with tighter gameplay, more personality, and a brand-new hero joining the fight!

[h1]🆕 What's New in v1.2:[/h1]
[b]✨ New Stats
[/b]Including Luck, Interest, and more — opening up new build possibilities.

[b]🃏 New Hero: The Jester
[/b]A chaotic and luck-driven fighter bringing unpredictability and charm.

[b]🕹️ Improved UI & Controller Support
[/b]Navigation is smoother and more intuitive across menus and gameplay.

[b]⏱️ Faster Runs
[/b]We've halved the length — now 10 waves instead of 20 for quicker, more action-packed sessions.

[b]📈 Progress Tracking
[/b]You can now see which difficulties you've cleared with each hero.

[b]🎯 Smarter Spell Offerings
[/b]Spells are now more likely to match your current build (projectile vs. area).

[b]🧠 New Passive Abilities
[/b]Tons of new passives, including one that boosts projectile count and area size while running.

[b]💬 Hero Catchphrases
[/b]Each hero now has unique voice lines during character select for extra personality.

[b]🎵 New Music
[/b]A fresh soundtrack to enhance your slime-slaying sessions (let me know what you think!).

[b]💥 Impactful Combat
[/b]Weapon hits now include camera shake (optional in settings).

[b]❤️ Low HP Effects
[/b]Heartbeat SFX and a screen-darkening effect add tension when your health gets low (also optional).

🚀 Try the Updated Demo Now!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428930/Slime_Attack_Survivor/]🎮 Play & Wishlist on Steam[/url]

notes.title: 🔥 Game Update – New Item Upgrade System & Major Balance Changes! 🔥
notes.content:
The biggest update yet is here! I've revamped progression, reworked balance, and introduced a brand-new Item Upgrade System to make every run more exciting.

[h1]🆕 Major Features:[/h1]
[h2]
[b]🔧 New Item Upgrade System[/b] [/h2] Customize your build like never before! Each upgrade offers choices (some RNG-based), adding deeper strategy and unique playstyles every run.

[h2][b]🛒 Shop Improvements [/b][/h2] Once you buy an item, it won’t appear again, making upgrades faster and more efficient! No more clutter—just the gear you need.

[h2][b]⚖️ Balance System & Difficulty Scaling[/b][/h2] A smoother progression curve for a more rewarding challenge without unnecessary spikes.

[h2][b]🗺️ Map Size Adjustments[/b] [/h2] Smaller, more action-packed battlefields to keep the intensity high! Less wandering, more fighting.

[h2][b]🩸 Lifesteal Rework[/b] [/h2]Now applies only to weapons & spells. Multi-hit attacks trigger lifesteal only once, making it more balanced.

[h2][b]❤️ HP Overhaul [/b][/h2] HP has doubled, with all HP-scaling mechanics adjusted accordingly for better survivability and strategy.

This update makes every decision more impactful, every upgrade more rewarding, and every battle more intense. 💥

[i]Jump in now and start shaping your ultimate build! 🚀[/i]

notes.title: Slime Attack: Survivor - Demo Update 1.14!
notes.content:
I’m excited to share Demo 1.14, bringing some big new features and improvements to the game!

🐾 New Pet System
Every hero now has a unique pet that fights alongside them! These loyal companions add a new layer of strategy, helping you take down enemies in their own way.

🧙‍♂️ New Hero: Necromancer & New Staff - Tombcaller
A powerful new hero joins the fight! The Necromancer commands the undead, summoning zombies with his signature Tombcaller Staff to overwhelm enemies. Designed after "Broken's Playz"!

🗺️ Bigger Map & More Challenge
The battlefield has been expanded, giving you more space to maneuver. Difficulty 3 is now more challenging, pushing your skills to the limit!

🔍 Zoom Out with Mouse Scroll
You can now zoom out slightly using the mouse scroll, giving you better battlefield awareness and control.

I hope you enjoy the update! As always, I’d love to hear your feedback—thanks for playing! 🎮

notes.title: 🔥 Slime Attack: Survivor – Demo Update v1.12 is Here! 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422958/4b3fe2d880c60b7210d4efe5b2545f0d1b719b13.png[/img]

Brace yourself for an electrifying new experience! The latest update completely overhauls the battlefield, introduces new strategic challenges, and brings powerful new ways to enhance your playstyle. Here's what’s new:

🧑‍🎨  [b]Enhanced Game Environment: [/b]The environment has been completely redone, making every wave more immersivethan ever!

⚔️ [b]New Challenge System:[/b] Random challenges now appear on certain waves! Complete them to earn powerful rewards and push your survival to the next level!

🪨 [b]Rocky Obstacles:[/b] Rocks now block the path of both you and enemies, forcing you to adapt your movement and strategy!

💨[b] Dash Rework & New Passive:[/b] Dash no longer costs HP but has a +2s cooldown. Want the old dash back? Buy a new passive that brings back the HP cost, reduces cooldown, and grants a DMG buff when dashing!

⚡[b] Sprint Passive Raises Dodge Cap:[/b] A new Sprint Passive now raises the dodge cap from 60% to 80%, letting you evade even more attacks! Plus, even more interactive and fun passives to discover!

❤️ [b]HP Bar Markers:[/b] Instantly gauge your max HP with new visual markers!

⚖️ [b]Balancing Tweaks:[/b] Fine-tuned for even smoother and more satisfying gameplay!

[i]Try out the update and share your feedback. Your input is invaluable in enhancing the game experience. 🎮[/i]
